Firefox Settings let you customize how your browser works, from restoring sessions and blocking ads to syncing data and managing privacy. This article explains each settings panel and includes links to common tasks.

To open Firefox Settings:
[[Template:optionspreferences]] The {for not fx152}{menu General} settings panel{/for}{for fx152}{menu Account and sync} settings page{/for} will open.
For other settings, select a different  {for not fx152}panel{/for}{for fx152}page{/for} from the left column.
;{for not fx148}[[Image:Fx130Settings-Simplified|width=600]]{/for}{for fx148}{for not fx152}[[Image:Fx148Settings-Simplified|width=600]]{/for}{for fx152}[[Image:Fx152BetaSettings-Simplified|width=600]]{/for}

=Overview of Firefox Settings=
{for fx152}
==Account and sync==
This page includes default browser, Mozilla account, sync, import browser data, Profiles and more:
*'''Default browser:''' Make Firefox your [[Make Firefox your default browser|default browser]].
*'''Account:''' Manage your Mozilla account and [[Access Mozilla services with a Mozilla account|access Mozilla services]] with your Mozilla account.
*'''Sync:''' [[Sync Firefox data|Sync Firefox data]] such as bookmarks, passwords, history and more across devices:
**[[How do I set up Sync on my computer?]]
**[[How do I choose what types of information to sync on Firefox?]]
*'''Import browser data:''' [[Import data from another browser|Import data]] from another browser.
*'''Profiles:''' [[Manage Firefox profiles]].
*'''Backup:''' [[Restore your Firefox browsing data with a backup file|Back up and restore Firefox data with a backup file]].
{/for}
{for not fx152}
==General==
This panel includes startup, tab behavior, downloads, language settings and more:
*'''Startup:''' Set Firefox as your default browser and restore previous sessions.
**Make Firefox your [[Make Firefox your default browser|default browser]].
**Set Firefox to [[Restore previous session - Configure when Firefox shows your most recent tabs and windows|restore your previous session]] at startup.
**[[Import data from another browser|Import data]] from another browser.
*'''Tabs:''' Manage your tabs.
**Choose how [[Tab preferences and settings|tabs are opened]].
*'''Language and appearance:''' Change fonts, colors, zoom level and interface language.
**[[Change website appearance settings in Firefox|Change website appearance]] settings in Firefox.
**Change [[Change the fonts and colors websites use|the fonts and colors websites use]].
**Change [[Font size and zoom - increase the size of web pages|the size of webpage content]].
**Choose [[Use Firefox in another language|the language to display menus, notifications, messages and other parts]] of the Firefox interface.
**Choose [[Choose display languages for multilingual web pages|a preferred display language for web pages]].
**Use [[How do I use the Firefox spell checker?|the Firefox spell checker]].
*'''Downloads:''' Choose where downloaded files are saved.
**[[Where to find and manage downloaded files in Firefox#w_change-where-downloads-are-saved|Change the download folder Firefox uses]] to save files.
*'''Firefox updates:'''
**Check your update history or change update settings for Firefox.
*'''Applications:''' Set how Firefox handles different file types.
**[[Manage file types and download actions in Firefox|Change the application used or the action taken]] for different file types.
**Choose whether to [[Watch DRM content on Firefox|watch DRM content in Firefox]].
*'''Performance:''' Adjust hardware acceleration and content processes.
**Customize [[Firefox's performance settings|performance settings]] in Firefox.
*'''Browsing:'''
**[[Accessibility features in Firefox - Make Firefox and web content work for all users#w_using-a-keyboard-to-navigate-within-webpages|Always use the cursor keys to navigate within pages (caret browsing)]].
**[[Accessibility features in Firefox - Make Firefox and web content work for all users#w_search-for-text-when-you-start-to-type|Search for text when you start typing]].
**[[Turn picture-in-picture mode controls on and off|Enable Picture-in-Picture video controls]].
**[[Control audio or video playback with your keyboard|Control media via keyboard, headset or virtual device]].
**[[Recommendations from Firefox|Recommend extensions as you browse]].
**[[Recommendations from Firefox|Recommend features as you browse]].
*{for not fx149}'''Network Settings:'''{/for}{for fx149}'''Proxy settings:'''{/for} Set up proxies or manage connection settings.
**Change [[Connection settings in Firefox|Firefox connection settings]] and set a proxy to connect to the Internet.
{/for}

{for not fx152}
==Home==
Customize what appears when you open Firefox:
*'''Homepage and new windows:''' Set a custom URL or use the default Firefox Home.
**Choose what you see when you open your [[How to set the home page|home page]], a new Firefox window or a new tab.
**Set your home page or new windows to the [[New Tab page in Firefox|default Firefox home page]], a blank page or a custom URL.
*'''New tabs:''' Choose what appears on new tab pages.
**You can set new tabs to open the default Firefox home page or a blank page.
*'''Firefox Home content:''' Toggle web search, top sites, recommendations and more.
**Customize content on the [[New Tab page in Firefox|New Tab page]], including Web Search, shortcuts to most visited sites, [[Recommended stories on the Firefox New Tab page - FAQ|recommended stories]] and recent activity.
{note}'''Note:''' For more information about these features, see [[Customize items on your Firefox New Tab page]].{/note}
{/for}
{for fx152}
==Home and startup==
Customize what appears when you open Firefox:
*'''Default browser:''' [[Make Firefox your default browser]].
*'''On startup:''' Set Firefox to [[Restore previous session - Configure when Firefox shows your most recent tabs and windows|restore your previous windows and tabs]] at startup.
*'''Homepage:''' Set a custom URL or use the default Firefox Home.
**Choose what you see when you open your [[How to set the home page|home page]], a new Firefox window or a new tab.
**Set your home page or new windows to the default [[New Tab page in Firefox|default Firefox home page]], a blank page or a custom URL.

**Customize content on the [[New Tab page in Firefox|New Tab page]], including Web Search, shortcuts to most visited sites, [[Recommended stories on the Firefox New Tab page - FAQ|recommended stories]] and recent activity.
{note}'''Note:''' For more information about these features, see [[Customize items on your Firefox New Tab page]].{/note}

==Privacy & Security==
Manage privacy, security and site permissions:
*'''Enhanced Tracking Protection:''' Block trackers and cookies.
**Control settings for the Firefox [[Enhanced Tracking Protection in Firefox for desktop|Enhanced Tracking Protection]].
*'''Cookies and site data:''' Manage or clear data stored by websites.
**Control whether [[Global Privacy Control|websites can sell or share your data]].
**Manage [[Cookies - Information that websites store on your computer|website cookies]].
**Manage [[Manage local site storage settings|website data storage]].
**Manage [[How to clear the Firefox cache|cached web content]].
*'''Logins and passwords:''' Control password saving and autofill.
**Manage [[Password Manager - Remember, delete and edit logins and passwords in Firefox|passwords]].
**Fill in [[Control whether Firefox automatically fills in forms|forms]].
*'''History:''' Manage browsing, download and search history.
**Manage [[Delete browsing, search and download history on Firefox|your browsing, download, search and form history]].
*'''Permissions:''' Control website access to your location, camera, notifications and more.
**Manage [[Web Push notifications in Firefox|Web Push notifications]].
**Manage [[Pop-up blocker settings, exceptions and troubleshooting|pop-up windows]].
**Manage warnings when websites try to [[Find and install add-ons to add features to Firefox|install add-ons]].
*'''Firefox data collection and use:''' Decide whether to share usage data.
**Allow Firefox to [[Share telemetry data with Mozilla to help improve Firefox|send technical and interactive data]] to Mozilla.
**Install and run [[About Studies|studies]].
**Send [[Mozilla Crash Reporter|crash reports]] to Mozilla.
**View and manage [[Secure website certificate|website certificates]] and security devices.
**Block [[How does built-in Phishing and Malware Protection work?|dangerous content or downloads]].
{for not fx143}
*'''Website Advertising Preferences''' <!-- setting and Learn more link no longer exists in fx143 and above. See https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/privacy-preserving-attribution/discuss/15382 (bug 1979093) -->
**Allow websites to perform [[Privacy-Preserving Attribution|privacy-preserving ad measurement]]
{/for}
*'''HTTPS-Only Mode:''' Enable encrypted connections only.
**Enable or disable [[HTTPS-Only Mode in Firefox|HTTPS-Only Mode]].
{/for}
{for fx152}

==AI Controls==
This panel provides a place to [[Block generative AI features with Firefox AI controls|block generative AI features in Firefox]]:
*You can use the '''Block AI enhancements''' switch to block all new or current AI features in Firefox.
*You can review and manage individual AI features available in Firefox, in [[Firefox Translations|website translations]], when you [[Add alt text to images in your PDFs using Firefox|add alt text to PDF images]], when you use AI-enhanced [[How to use AI-enhanced tab groups|Tab group suggestions]] or when you [[Preview webpages in Firefox with link preview|view key points in link previews]].
*You can block or manage [[Access AI chatbots in Firefox|AI Chatbots in Firefox]].
{/for}
{for fx152}

***Install and run [[About Studies|studies]].

=Common questions about Firefox settings=
==How do I restore a previous session or reopen closed tabs?==
Firefox can restore your tabs from your last browsing session:
#[[Template:optionspreferences]]
#Open the {menu General} panel.
#Under ''Startup'', check the box for '''Open tabs from the previous session'''.
{note}'''Note:''' If you accidentally closed a tab or window, press {key Ctrl+Shift+T} (Windows/Linux) or {key Command+Shift+T} (Mac) to reopen it.{/note}

==How can I block or reduce ads?==
Firefox includes Enhanced Tracking Protection and optional add-ons to help block intrusive ads:
#[[Template:optionspreferences]]
#Open the {menu Privacy and security} panel.
#Under ''Enhanced Tracking Protection'', select '''Strict''' for more ad and tracker blocking.
#To block more ads, consider installing a content blocker like uBlock Origin from the [https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/ Firefox Add-ons site].

==How do I organize my bookmarks?==
You can manage bookmarks from the Library:
#Click the menu [[Image:Fx89menuButton]] button and select {menu Bookmarks}.
#Select {menu Manage bookmarks} at the bottom.
#Use folders to organize your saved pages.
{/for}
